steps.npc: Well, now. Do you always go around asking about people like that? It's very rude, you know.

steps.player: Sorry! I didn't mean to pry!

steps.npc: That's alright. My name is Louisiana Jones, although most people call me Anna. I'm an archaeologist.

steps.player: Oh. Do you work for the Varrock Museum?

steps.npc: Hah! No. I used to, but now I prefer to work freelance for independent employers.
I'm investigating something for someone.
I never said it would.
I'm afraid I can't say.

steps.player: Okay, so who are you investigating it for?

steps.npc: I'm afraid I can't say that either.

steps.player: Okay, so is there anything you CAN say?

steps.npc: I can say that I can't say anything about what you want me to say!

steps.player: Okay, I think you've said enough!

steps.npc: That, my dear, is the statue of the great god Saradomin himself. Stand and admire in awe, for you are in the presence of greatness!
WHAT?!?!

steps.player: Uh...I said I've lost my anorak!

steps.npc: I see. I'm afraid I haven't seen it.
Okay, then!

before-what-lies-below-attempting-to-exc.npc: Excuse me. I am working on that statue at the moment. Please don't touch it.

before-what-lies-below-attempting-to-exc.player: You are? But you're just sitting there.
Oh, I see. When does your break finish?

before-what-lies-below-attempting-to-exc.npc: When I decide to start work again. Right now, I'm enjoying sitting on this bench.

after-completing-what-lies-below-while-t.npc: Ah. You must be [player name], right? I have a bronze pickaxe here for you!
My employer, Surok Magis, sent word to me that you may come to use the tunnel. You will need something to help you get in there. The pickaxe I've given to you should help.

steps.npc: Why, the Chaos Tunnel of course! I imagine Surok will have told you of it.

steps.player: Oh, I see. Well, what can you tell me about it?

steps.npc: Well, story and rumour has it that the Dagon'hai built a tunnel here under the statue of Saradomin that would allow them to visit the Chaos Altar without having to go through the Wilderness.
Yes, it is. Or, at least, it would be. Unfortunately, I haven't been able to get in there so far.
The tunnel entrance needs to be cleared before anyone can get in there. However, my Mining skill isn't high enough at all to do it myself. Perhaps you could have a go?

excavating-the-statue.npc: You did it! Oh, well done! How exciting!

excavating-the-statue.player: Right, well, I better see what's down there, then.

after-excavating-the-statue.npc: You opened the tunnel; well done!

after-excavating-the-statue.player: Aren't you going to go inside?

after-excavating-the-statue.npc: I'd better not. My orders were to open up the entrance and wait for Surok to arrive. When he gets here, we'll go in together. He promised me a lot of gold for this job!

after-excavating-the-statue.player: Okay, then. I'm going in to have a look!
